name: shopping-agent
description: Verify same-product offers and expose evidence-bounded ZIP pricing status across a bounded Shopify registry.

interface.shortDescription: Verify offers and pricing evidence across Shopify stores.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.3.1 searches a 45-store technically audited Shopify Storefront registry once, verifies same-product identity, accepts a US ZIP and memberships, reports verified regular item price and freshness, marks unverified shipping, tax, fees, member price, and delivered price unavailable instead of estimating them, and uses authorized Chrome only after complete zero-result API coverage.
defaultPrompt: Shopify first; call search_shopify_products once. Use comparisonMode=SAME_PRODUCT for comparisons; otherwise DISCOVERY.
